arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gassy smell as urgent. Please don't use the oven, and don't use any lighters, flames or electrical switches near it. Open the windows, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger, call 999. We are arranging a gas engineer through the landlord's property record and a member of our team is picking this up now. We will be in touch again today about the oven and the engineer visit. Please don't go back in until you've been told it is safe.
